title: Positivity of the prefix potential
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite two-player zero-sum game with at least one row action, fix a learning rate $\eta \in \bbr$, and let $a_0, \dots, a_{t-1}$ be any prefix of column actions. Then the prefix potential is strictly positive,
\[
  \Phi_t \;=\; \sum_{i} \exp\!\bigl(-\eta\, L_t(i)\bigr) \;>\; 0,
\]
where $L_t(i)$ is the prefix cumulative loss of row $i$.
hypotheses_covered: a prefix of t column actions
replaced:
When $M \ge 1$, the prefix potential $\Phi_t > 0$, since it is a non-empty sum
of positive terms.
